---
title: "What xdssat covers"
subtitle: "What the DSSAT engine can do, which of it xdssat runs on a grid, and what the rest would take"
---

xdssat drives the unmodified DSSAT-CSM 4.8 engine. The engine can do more than xdssat sets up on a grid.
Everything the engine can do stays available by running it on single experiments, as the
[training notebooks](../learn/index.qmd) do. This page lists the engine's capabilities, says for each how
xdssat handles it, and, for what it does not support, what supporting it would take.

Engine facts come from the DSSAT-CSM source (`dssat-csm-os`, version 4.8.6.4); file and line references are
given where they matter. xdssat facts come from its code and settings.

## How to read the status

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Grid** | Set in the experiment file or a prepared input; runs on every cell and season. |
| **Template** | Works when the template experiment carries it. xdssat copies the section and moves its dates with planting, but no experiment-file setting changes it: edit the template. |
| **Single field** | In the training notebooks (`docs/notebooks/learnlib.py`, `glue.py`) or a script for experiments, not in the gridded runner. |
| **Not supported** | Refused or absent. The last section says what supporting it would take. |

## Running the engine

| Capability | DSSAT engine | xdssat | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Run the treatments of an experiment | mode A | one experiment file per chunk of cells, run in parallel (`src/runner.py`) | Grid |
| Many seasons and years | years per treatment, or `NYERS` | one treatment per cell, season and year (`years`) | Grid |
| Crop sequences, soil carried from crop to crop | mode Q with a batch file | `.SQX` template (`src/sequence.py`); crops labelled by sowing date | Grid |
| Batch, spatial and seasonal batch modes | modes B, S, N | not used: xdssat chunks the cells itself | Grid, another way |
| Yield forecast within a season | mode Y with a forecast date (`FODAT`) | none | Not supported |
| Cultivar estimation with GenCalc | modes G and T | GLUE instead (see below) | Not supported |
| Interactive and sensitivity modes | modes I and E, read from the keyboard | scenarios replace them | Not supported |

## Inputs

| Capability | DSSAT engine | xdssat | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Daily weather from files | `.WTH`, weather method M | gridded, hourly and point sources, NASA POWER ([Input data](data.qmd)) | Grid |
| Weather generators WGEN and SIMMETEO | weather methods W and S with a `.CLI` file | none | Not supported |
| Soil profiles | `.SOL` | SoilGrids with Saxton and Rawls, or your own profiles and soil map; `slpf`, `soc_scale` | Grid |
| Soil analysis section | `*SOIL ANALYSIS` (`IPSLIN.for`) | refused (`filex.UNSUPPORTED`) | Not supported |
| Initial soil water and nitrogen | `*INITIAL CONDITIONS` | `treatments > initial_soil_water`, nitrate and ammonium by depth from the template; `scenarios > management` for the IC fields | Grid |
| Where the crop is, and its water regime | none: the engine runs one field | crop mask, water regime, region and zone maps | Grid |

## Crops and cultivars

| Capability | DSSAT engine | xdssat | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rice, maize, pearl millet | CERES-Rice, CERES-Maize, CERES-Millet | templates `XDRI8601.RIX`, `XDRW8601.RIX`, `XDMZ8201.MZX`, `XDML8601.MLX` | Grid |
| Any other crop the engine has | its crop models | a template experiment of your own ([Another crop](another-crop.qmd)) | Template |
| Choice of model for a crop | `SMODEL` | the template's | Template |
| Cultivar choice and coefficients | `.CUL` | `cultivars`; `scenarios > cultivar_coefficients` | Grid |
| Ecotype and species coefficients | `.ECO`, `.SPE` | copied unchanged | Not supported |

## Management

| Capability | DSSAT engine | xdssat | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Planting dates and calendars | `PDATE` | uniform, by zone or by rain onset per cell; `scenarios > planting_offset_days` | Grid |
| Plant population, row spacing, depth | `*PLANTING DETAILS` | `scenarios > management` (MP fields) | Grid |
| Automatic planting window | `PLANT A` | `scenarios > simulation` (`PLANT`, `PH2OL` ... `PSTMN`); window dates move with planting | Grid |
| Nitrogen rate | `*FERTILIZERS` | `treatments > nitrogen_kg` to the template's levels | Grid |
| Fertilizer timing, source and depth | `*FERTILIZERS` | the template's | Template |
| Irrigation, reported or automatic | `*IRRIGATION`, `IRRIG` | `treatments > water_regimes` to template levels; `scenarios > simulation` (`IRRIG`, `IMDEP`, `ITHRL`, `ITHRU`, `IRAMT`, `IREFF`) | Grid |
| Rice flood, bunds, puddling, percolation | operations `IR006` to `IR011` | template levels (`XDRI8601`, `XDRW8601`) | Template |
| Residues and organic fertilizer | `*RESIDUES` | the template's | Template |
| Harvest | `*HARVEST`, `HARVS` | the template's; `scenarios > simulation` (`HARVS`, `HPCNP`, `HPCNR`) | Grid |
| Dates in days after planting (code D) | read as days, not dates | kept as days, not moved | Grid |
| Chemicals and tillage | `*CHEMICALS`, `*TILLAGE` | refused (`filex.UNSUPPORTED`) | Not supported |

## Processes and switches

| Capability | DSSAT engine | xdssat | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Water and nitrogen on or off: potential, water-limited, N-limited | `WATER`, `NITRO` | `scenarios > simulation` | Grid |
| Nitrogen fixation | `SYMBI` (legumes) | `scenarios > simulation`; needs a legume template | Template |
| Phosphorus and potassium | `PHOSP` (CROPGRO, CERES-Maize, CERES-Sorghum), `POTAS` (CERES-Maize, CERES-Rice); soil P and K needed | the switches pass, but the prepared soils carry no P or K | Not supported |
| Pests and diseases | `DISES` with `.PST` coefficients and observed damage | none | Not supported |
| CO2 and climate change | `CO2` option; `*ENVIRONMENT MODIFICATIONS` (8 variables) | `scenarios > simulation` (`CO2`); `scenarios > environment` | Grid |
| Methods: evapotranspiration, infiltration, photosynthesis, soil organic matter, soil evaporation, layers, soil temperature, greenhouse gases | `*SIMULATION CONTROLS` methods | `scenarios > simulation` (`EVAPO`, `INFIL`, `PHOTO`, `MESOM`, `MESEV`, `MESOL`, `METMP`, `MEGHG`) | Grid |

## Outputs

| Capability | DSSAT engine | xdssat | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Seasonal summary | `Summary.OUT`, `summary.csv` | `summary.csv` and a CF netCDF per run: yield, biomass, LAI, water and nitrogen terms, dates, crop area | Grid |
| Daily outputs | plant growth, soil water, nitrogen, carbon, temperature, weather ... | `run > daily` with 16 groups | Grid |
| Rice flood water | `FloodW.OUT` (text only) | `learnlib.read_flood` | Single field |

## Analysis, calibration and evaluation

None of these are in the engine itself; DSSAT provides them as separate tools.

| Capability | DSSAT | xdssat | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Seasonal and risk analysis: distributions, CDF, mean and variance | Seasonal Analysis tool | `src/seasonal.py`, `scripts/seasonal_summary.py` | Grid |
| Economics: prices, costs, gross margin | Seasonal Analysis tool | `seasonal.Economics` | Grid |
| Comparison with yield statistics by region | none | `scripts/compare_regions.py`; `compare_districts.py` for Java | Grid |
| Yield-gap factor fitted to statistics | `SLPF` | `scripts/fit_slpf.py` | Grid |
| Cultivar calibration with GLUE | GLUE tool | `src/glue.py`, `scripts/glue_calibrate.py` on experiments with measurements | Single field |
| Evaluation against measurements | FileA, FileT, `Evaluate.OUT` | FileA and FileT read and write, RMSE, Willmott's d (`learnlib.py`) | Single field |

## What the rest would take

Each capability xdssat does not support, with what supporting it would need. The effort is an estimate of
the work on xdssat's side.

| Capability | Feasible | What it would take, or why not | Effort (estimate) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Soil analysis section | yes | Copy the section from the template like the others and move its date (`SADAT`) with planting. The engine reads it only when nitrogen is on (`IPSLIN.for:247-434`). | small |
| Chemicals and tillage | yes | Copy both sections from the template and move their dates with planting. The engine always reads their dates as calendar dates (`IPCHEM.for:95`, `IPTILL.for:91`), so moving them is consistent. | small |
| Ecotype and species coefficients | yes | Write the `.ECO` and `.SPE` files with overrides, as xdssat already does for `.CUL`. | small |
| Yield forecast within a season | yes, with conditions | Run mode Y with a forecast date (`FODAT`, the eleventh row of the automatic management section) per cell. How the engine joins the season's weather to past years has to be checked in its source first. | moderate |
| Weather generators | yes | A `.CLI` file per cell from the monthly statistics of the prepared weather, and weather method W or S. Useful for long synthetic series; observed gridded weather covers most runs. | moderate |
| GenCalc | not pursued | Its modes G and T swap in their own cultivar files (`GENCALC2.CUL`, `ipexp.for:504-529`) and expect measured experiments per cultivar; cultivar calibration is done with GLUE. | - |
| Phosphorus and potassium | limited by data | The engine supports them for a few crop models only, and needs soil P and K in the profiles; SoilGrids has no P and K pools in DSSAT's form. Feasible where you bring your own profiles with P and K. | moderate, once data exist |
| Pests and diseases | no, on a grid | The engine needs pest coefficients (`.PST`) and observed damage over time for each field; gridded damage data do not exist. | - |
| Interactive and sensitivity modes | no | They read from the keyboard (`CSM.for:577-584`); scenarios do the same work in a script. | - |
